_comment: Template for webkit.config.json. Fill project_name, site_root, default_page, lock_dir, palette ports, browser, and feedback_dir for the project. site_root is the served document root; feedback_dir stays relative to the Git root. The server binds to 127.0.0.1 unless bind_host is explicitly added. Supported bind_host values are 127.0.0.1, localhost, and 0.0.0.0. The non-loopback value 0.0.0.0 also requires an allowed_hosts list of exact hostnames or IPv4 addresses without ports; IPv6 is not supported in v0.8.19. hotkeys values are layout-independent KeyboardEvent.code names; the Control Center can set them globally. The open/close shortcut stays disabled in editable fields. The dictation shortcut may start whenever a Webkit feedback textbox is empty, including after deleting earlier text, and otherwise stays disabled in editable fields. dictation.mode is speech (Chrome recognition, default), voice-note (record audio for local agent transcription), or cloud-voice-note (record audio for OpenAI transcription). interaction.mode is browse-default (click the website normally and hold Alt/Option to draw, default) or draw-default (draw normally and hold Alt/Option to interact).
